name: MicroBurst - Azure Recon and Attack (PowerShell)
description: MicroBurst is a PowerShell toolkit for Azure assessment and attack: anonymous blob/storage enumeration, subdomain/service discovery, dumping credentials from Automation Accounts / Key Vaults / App Services, RunCommand on VMs, and token/credential harvesting. Covers both unauthenticated recon and authenticated post-exploitation across Azure services.
notes:
=== LOAD ===
  Import-Module .\MicroBurst.psm1

=== UNAUTHENTICATED RECON ===
  Invoke-EnumerateAzureBlobs -Base <keyword>        # guess public storage blobs
  Invoke-EnumerateAzureSubDomains -Base <keyword>   # *.azurewebsites.net etc.

=== AUTHENTICATED (Connect-AzAccount first) ===
  Get-AzPasswords                 # dump creds: Key Vault, Automation, App Service, ACR
  Get-AzDomainInfo                # tenant/subscription inventory -> files
  Invoke-AzVMBulkCMD   -Command "whoami"            # RunCommand on all VMs you can
  Get-AzStorageKeys

=== REST / TOKEN HELPERS ===
  Get-AzureADToken / REST modules under Az/ and REST/

=== OUTPUT ===
  # Get-AzDomainInfo writes CSV/JSON inventory; Get-AzPasswords prints a creds table

=== ALTERNATIVES ===
  AADInternals   # Entra/M365 identity attacks
  ScoutSuite     # config audit
  roadrecon      # offline Entra graph
  PowerZure      # (archived) similar Az attack set

recommended.note: ScoutSuite for a full config audit view.
Managed-identity token abuse pairs with VM RunCommand.

defense.why_it_works: MicroBurst mixes anonymous storage/subdomain probing (public endpoints) with authenticated Az API calls. Credential extraction (Get-AzPasswords) and VM RunCommand use legitimate management operations granted to Contributor-level identities, so the risk is over-privileged roles rather than an exploit.
defense.prerequisites: Unauthenticated recon: nothing but a keyword. Credential dumping / RunCommand: an authenticated principal with Contributor or specific resource rights.
defense.impact: Discovery of public storage, extraction of secrets from Key Vaults/Automation/App Services, and arbitrary command execution on Azure VMs.
defense.detection: [MITRE T1552.005/T1580] Azure Activity logs for Key Vault secret reads, Automation credential access, Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/runCommand/action, and listKeys on storage; bursts of anonymous 404/200 against *.blob.core.windows.net.
defense.artifacts: Azure Activity log (runCommand, listKeys, Vault Get Secret), Key Vault diagnostic logs (SecretGet), storage analytics logs, Automation job logs.
defense.splunk_spl:
index=azure sourcetype=azure:activity (operationName.value="Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/runCommand/action" OR operationName.value="Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/secrets/read" OR operationName.value="*listKeys/action")
| stats count by caller, operationName.value, resourceId
defense.sentinel_kql:
AzureActivity
| where OperationNameValue has "runCommand" or OperationNameValue has "listKeys" or OperationNameValue has "secrets/read"
| summarize Count=count() by Caller, OperationNameValue, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where Count > 1
defense.prevention: Least-privilege (avoid broad Contributor); private endpoints and no anonymous blob access; Key Vault RBAC + firewall + purge protection; restrict and log runCommand; Defender for Cloud alerts on secret access and VM command execution.

detections.name: Azure credential dump + VM RunCommand (MicroBurst)
detections.logic:
AzureActivity
| where OperationNameValue has "runCommand" or OperationNameValue has "listKeys" or OperationNameValue has "secrets"
| summarize Ops=make_set(OperationNameValue), Count=count() by Caller, bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| where Count > 2
detections.tuning: Allowlist deployment principals; alert on interactive users doing this
